q: R. A. Torrey yava mu maka ga ngeri ki, era yasoma atya?
a: Reuben Archer Torrey yazaalibwa nga 28 Janwaali 1856 mu maka ag'obugagga e Hoboken, mu New Jersey, era n'ajja e Yale ng'alina emyaka kkumi n'etaano. Yafunirayo diguli ye esooka mu 1878 era n'asigala ku ssomero ly'eby'obwakatonda, bwe kityo obulamu bwe obw'omu buvubuka ne bugatta obugagga obw'amazima n'okusoma okw'omutindo ogwa waggulu. Emabega w'ebyo byonna waaliwo nnyina, omukazi ow'okusaba okutakoma eyamala emyaka ng'asaba Katonda obulokozi bw'omwana we n'obuweereza bwe.

q: Torrey yali mubuusabuusa, era okukyuka kwe kwabaawo kutya ddala?
a: Yali mubuusabuusa ddala: emyaka gye egy'e Yale yali agiwadde eby'amazannyo, ekifo ky'okuvuganya embalaasi n'okunywa okungi, era yeeyita omukulembeze w'ekibinja ky'essomero eky'okusattulula Ebyawandiikibwa, omuvubuka eyanyumirwanga okusattulula enjigiriza. Okubuusabuusa kwe kwatuuka ku njegoyego z'okuggwaamu essuubi, era ku kiro ky'omu ttoggo mu 1875 omuvubuka ow'emyaka kkumi na mwenda yatuula yekka mu kisenge kye ng'amaliridde okumalawo obulamu bwe, ng'alina ekyokukozesa mu ngalo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo yeesanga ng'asaba, ng'ajjukira emyaka emingi nnyina gye yamusabira, era n'asuubiza nti singa Katonda amuwonya yandikoze kyonna ky'amusaba — "I'll even preach!" (ne mbuulira kyennyini!). Yagolokoka nga muntu mulala, n'ayatula okukkiriza kwe mu lwatu mu kkanisa ya Yale, era teyaddayo nnyuma ku ndagaano eyo.

q: Lwaki yagenda okusomera mu Bugirimaani, era yeeyongera okuwolereza Bayibuli oluvannyuma?
a: Mu 1882 Torrey yatwala ebibuuzo bye eri ensibuko yaabyo, ng'asomera e Leipzig ne Erlangen wansi w'abayivu nga Franz Delitzsch ne Theodor Zahn — ekigo kyennyini eky'okunoonyereza okw'ekitiibwa okwali kimu ku by'akola edda. Yakomawo eka ng'akutte ekyawukana n'ekyo kye yali agenze okukakasa, era n'amala obulamu bwe obusigadde ng'awolereza Ebyawandiikibwa bye yali yeekenneenyeza n'amaaso ge. Oluvannyuma yali omu ku bateereza The Fundamentals, olukalala olw'ebitabo kkumi na bibiri olwawa erinnya ekibiina kye yandinnyonnyodde mu bwangu ng'okukkiriza ekyo Bayibuli ky'egamba.

q: Yakwatagana atya ne D. L. Moody?
a: Mu kaweefube ow'okubuulira e New Haven emyaka egyali giyiseewo, Moody yali agambye Torrey omuvubuka nti, "Young man, you'd better get to work for God!" (Muvubuka, osaanidde okutandika okukolera Katonda!). Mu 1889 Moody yamutumya, era ng'alina emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu Torrey n'afuuka omukulembeze w'essomero ly'e Chicago ensi lye yandimanyi ng'Essomero lya Bayibuli erya Moody, ekifo kye yakwata okutuusa mu 1908. Mu 1894 era yatwala obusumba bw'Ekkanisa ey'oku Chicago Avenue — kaakano Ekkanisa ya Moody — era n'abuulira eyo okumala emyaka kkumi n'ebiri.

q: Kaweefube we ow'okubuulira okwetooloola ensi yali atya?
a: Okuva mu 1902 okutuuka mu 1905, ng'ali n'omukulembeze w'ennyimba Charles M. Alexander, Torrey yabuulira mu Australia ne New Zealand, mu China, Japan ne Buyindi, era n'okuyita mu Bizinga bya Bungereza. Ku Bingley Hall mu Birmingham abantu nga kasanvu baayatula okukyusibwa mu mwezi gumu, era kaweefube ow'e London ow'omu 1905 yatandika mu Febwaali okutuuka mu Juuni ng'abajja bonna awamu basukka mu kakadde. Yabuusabuusa emiwendo egyo wadde nga ye yaginyumya, era n'agaana enkuŋŋaana okwogerwako ng'ekyo ky'amaze okutuukiriza.

q: Lwaki okusaba kukulu nnyo mu ngeri Torrey gy'ajjukirwamu?
a: Mu Minneapolis mu 1888 yaleka omusaala gwe alyoke akolere abaavu era n'ateeka obulamu bw'amaka ge bwonna ku kusaba, oluvannyuma ng'agamba nti tewaali kyakulya wadde kkooti eyabajjira ebitaali kuddibwamu kwa kusaba. Okuva mu 1898 yakulembera okusaba ku Lwomukaaga akawungeezi ku Ssomero lya Bayibuli, abantu okutuuka ku bikumi bisatu gye baasabanga, wiiki ku wiiki, okufuka kw'Omwoyo mu nsi yonna. Era yasaba mu kyama atumibwe okwetooloola ensi ng'abuulira — era mu wiiki emu, nga tewali eyakisaba, okuyitibwa ne kuva mu makanisa g'e Australia.

q: Torrey yayigiriza ki ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu?
a: Kino yakinyigiriza okusinga ensonga endala yonna: nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu Muntu w'okumanyibwa so si maanyi ag'okukozesebwa, era nti waliwo okwambazibwa amaanyi olw'obuweereza omukkiriza kw'ayinza era kw'asaanidde okunoonya n'okufuna mu bujjuvu. Yeegendereza okugamba nti tekwali kulokolebwa kwa kubiri wadde akabonero k'obutukuvu obusingako, wabula kwambazibwa olw'omulimu okuweebwa Abakristaayo aba bulijjo. Mu ndowooza ye bangi baakola nga tewali kibala kirabika lwa nsonga nti tebaali basabye maanyi ago.

Mu 1912 Torrey yagenda ebugwanjuba okufuuka omukulu asooka ow'Essomero lya Bayibuli erya Los Angeles, era okuva mu 1915 omusumba asooka ow'Ekkanisa yaalyo ey'Oluggi Oluggule, ng'akwata byombi okutuuka mu 1924. Eyo yabumba omulembe omulala ogw'abayizi, nga mu bo mwe muli Charles E. Fuller. Era yali atandiseewo Olukiiko lwa Bayibuli olw'e Montrose mu Pennsylvania mu 1908, omulimu gw'okusomesa mu biseera by'ekyeya ogwamuwangaala.

q: Bitabo bye ki ebingi ebisinga okumanyibwa?
a: Torrey yawandiika ebitabo ebisukka mu amakumi ana era, okumala emyaka amakumi asatu, ekitabo eky'okunnyonnyola eky'essomero ly'oku Ssande ekyasomebwanga ennyo. Ebitabo bye eby'okuyamba mu bulamu obwa bulijjo bikyaliwo — What the Bible Teaches, How to Study the Bible ne How to Bring Men to Christ — naye ebyawangaala ennyo bye ebyo ebikwata ku kusaba ne ku Mwoyo, nga Engeri y'Okusaba, The Power of Prayer and the Prayer of Power, ne The Person and Work of the Holy Spirit. Ku nsonga ezo, kyagambibwa nti yali tayigiriza balala bokka wabula ng'anyumya ekyo kye yali agezesezza.

q: Torrey yafa ddi era wa, era ajjukirwa atya?
a: Yeeggyako ebifo bye eby'e Los Angeles mu 1924 alyoke addeyo mu kubuulira, ng'akyatambula era ng'akyabuulira, era n'ayigiriza nate ku Moody mu 1927. Yafiira mu maka ge mu Asheville, mu North Carolina, nga 26 Okitobba 1928, ng'alina emyaka nsanvu mu ebiri, era n'aziikibwa ku ttaka ly'olukiiko lw'e Montrose lwe yatandikawo. Abo abaamumanya obulungi tebaajjukira bibinja binene, wabula omusajja ow'okusaba okwa bulijjo era okutasalako eyali emabega wabyo.
